description: Liste des sites 2G/3G/4G/5G (T4 2022) is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ARCEP. Les " sites " désignent les équipements, généralement placés sur des points hauts, nécessaires à la transmission radio des réseaux mobiles. Un site comporte d'ordinaire plusieurs antennes et peut comporter plusieurs technologies (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G). Certains sites sont partagés entre plusieurs opérateurs: on dit alors que le site est "mutualisé". Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Aménagement. The portal shows 2,389 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-05-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
